dog.description_text:
Who is that handsome boy in the all white suit you may ask? It's none other than Melo, charmer extraordinaire. Melo pulls out all the stops when it comes to wooing his people pals. As if he couldn't be cuter, you can literally "tickle him pink" as Melo has a tendency to turn a rosy hue when excited and ready for snuggles.

Melo is on the search for a very special forever family, that can provide him with the perfect home. He is looking for a home in a quiet suburban or rural area, where there is a fully fenced in yard, with no other animals. However, there is more than enough of Melo to go around, so he's the only four-legged family member you'll need! A family that has previous experience with his needs is also idyllic. Melo is also seeking adopters with older children, as he enthusiastically plays and snuggles, and throws around all of his 50 pounds with lots of love and gusto.

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location! Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines. If you are interested in adopting or fostering, please contact us for further information on him and we can schedule an appointment for you to meet him.
dog.name: Melo
